msg: You want to select the green, yellow, orange and blue gnomes until you get to around 2/3 mushrooms a turn from them. With a x5 multiplier that will be 10 or 15. At that point, you want to switch to the other coloured gnomes. These two sets of gnomes (GYOB & others) take you to two distinct areas. Keep your hands on the keyboard, don't get distracted, lock in. Try and visualise it as a wave graph with two distinct lines, once one is at the top, the other is at the bottom. It swings like that in cycles.
